raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Fixes the Rust-frontend half of #58144.

`GUARDED_PREFIXES` only matched `/v1`, `/v2` and `/inference`, so any route outside those prefixes was reachable without a bearer token even when `--api-key` was configured. This includes `/tokenize`, `/detokenize`, `/metrics`, `/reset_prefix_cache`, `/reset_mm_cache`, `/reset_encoder_cache`, `/collective_rpc`, `/update_weights`, `/abort_requests`, `/sleep`, `/wake_up`, `/pause`, `/resume`, `/server_info`, `/get_world_size`, and `/start_profile`/`/stop_profile`.

This mirrors the same allowlist-of-guarded-prefixes defect that #58028 fixes on the Python frontend for the same issue. As noted in a comment on #58144: "The Rust frontend has the same bug ... `--api-key` behaves differently per frontend." This PR closes that gap on the Rust side.

## Fix

Replace `GUARDED_PREFIXES` (allowlist of what's guarded, fails open on new routes) with `UNGUARDED_PATHS` (allowlist of what's exempt — `/health`, `/load`, `/version`), so every route, present or added later, requires a token by default.

## Duplicate-work check

- `gh issue view 58144 --repo vllm-project/vllm --comments`
- `gh pr list --repo vllm-project/vllm --state open --search "58144 in:body"` → #58028 (Python side, still open) and #58341 (narrower `/invocations`-only patch) address the Python frontend; neither touches `rust/src/server/src/middleware/auth.rs`. This PR is scoped to the Rust frontend only, which a comment on #58144 explicitly flagged as unaddressed.

## Test Plan

- `cargo test -p vllm-server`
- `cargo fmt -p vllm-server -- --check`
- `cargo clippy -p vllm-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`

## Test Result

- `cargo test -p vllm-server`: 429 passed, 0 failed (includes 2 new regression tests proving `/tokenize` and `/metrics` now require a token, and that OPTIONS/CORS-preflight/guarded/unguarded behavior is unchanged)
- `cargo fmt -- --check`: clean
- `cargo clippy -- -D warnings`: clean

AI assistance was used (Claude Code) to draft and test this change; I reviewed every changed line and ran the commands above myself.

+#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
+#[serial]
+async fn api_key_auth_rejects_missing_token_on_tokenize() {
+    // Regression test: `/tokenize` renders arbitrary text through the chat
+    // template and was reachable without a token because the old allowlist
+    // only guarded "/v1", "/v2" and "/inference" prefixes.
+    let (mut app, _engine_task) = test_app_with_api_keys(vec!["secret".to_string()]).await;
+    let response = app
+        .call(
+            Request::builder()
+                .method("POST")
+                .uri("/tokenize")
+                .header("content-type", "application/json")
+                .body(Body::from("{}"))
+                .expect("build request"),
+        )
+        .await
+        .expect("call app");
+
+    assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED);
+}
+
+#[tokio::test(flavor = "multi_thread", worker_threads = 2)]
+#[serial]
+async fn api_key_auth_rejects_missing_token_on_metrics() {
+    // Regression test: "/metrics" was unreachable by GUARDED_PREFIXES and
+    // leaked server-internal metrics without a token.
+    let (mut app, _engine_task) = test_app_with_api_keys(vec!["secret".to_string()]).await;
+    let response = app
+        .call(
+            Request::builder()
+                .method("GET")
+                .uri("/metrics")
+                .body(Body::empty())
+                .expect("build request"),
+        )
+        .await
+        .expect("call app");
+
+    assert_eq!(response.status(), StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED);
+}
